key_insight: EgoWM converts pretrained video diffusion models into action‑conditioned egocentric world models, enabling controllable, accurate future prediction by repurposing Internet‑scale video priors without training from scratch.
problem_solved: How to get accurate, action‑conditioned future predictions from an egocentric viewpoint without costly task‑specific retraining of large video models—enabling controllable prediction for planning and embodied agents.
method: Architecture‑agnostic retrofit: transform any pretrained video diffusion model into an action‑conditioned world model (EgoWM) rather than training a new model from scratch.
Leverage Internet‑scale video priors to provide rich dynamics and visual realism, then inject action conditioning (via lightweight adapters/conditioning mechanisms) to steer predicted futures.
Produce egocentric, controllable future video rollouts that reflect specified agent actions for downstream planning and evaluation.
impact: Provides a practical, data‑efficient way to obtain controllable world models from existing generative priors, lowering compute/data costs and accelerating integration of powerful video models into robotics, embodied AI, and planning systems.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: pretrained video diffusion model → EgoWM adapter/conditioning → action‑conditioned future video outputs
Side‑by‑side frames: same initial egocentric frame with different predicted futures under different actions (visualizing controllability)
Egocentric camera + action overlay: arrow icons showing actions (move, turn, interact) and resulting predicted trajectories
Summary chart: qualitative/quantitative comparison showing reduced retraining cost and improved conditional prediction accuracy
paper_title: Walk through Paintings: Egocentric World Models from Internet Priors
paper_authors: Anurag Bagchi, Zhipeng Bao, Homanga Bharadhwaj, Yu-Xiong Wang, Pavel Tokmakov
